g.text: Gane–Sarson notation: square-cornered boxes are external entities, the rounded box is the process under study.
Level 0 asserts the system boundary — everything inside process 0 is decomposed in the level-1 diagram.
Every flow is named with the data it carries, never with the verb that moves it.
